title: Redstrike Scope Projection
description: The machine projection of an engagement's scope that scripts/console.py serves at /e/<id>/scope.json — produced by scope_yaml_to_json() from the canonical signed scope.yaml (or a real runtime/scope.json when present). The console reads target + window + in_scope/out_of_scope to render the engagement header and gate state. Tolerant (a hand-authored scope.json may carry extra keys); this pins the shapes the console depends on so a window or scope block that drifts to the wrong type (which would break header/date rendering) is caught.

source.description: where the projection came from, e.g. scope.yaml.

source_repo.description: Present for a white-box source audit: the authorized repository cloned under the engagement (engagements/<id>/source/). Its presence marks the engagement source-granted.

local_path.description: clone location relative to the engagement dir, e.g. source/.
